Management Plan
- management_plan_main_or_not_recorded: 
  - Likely viral upper respiratory infection; symptomatic management advised.
  - Continue current symptomatic treatment (Lemsip/lemon sips) — patient reports 2–3 per day; inform that Lemsip contains paracetamol and to avoid additional paracetamol-containing products concurrently.
  - Cough syrup discouraged during daytime; may use at night if cough prevents sleep.
  - Obtain and monitor temperature with a thermometer.
  - Re-contact clinician/GP if temperature persistently elevated (doctor referenced >37.5–38°C), ongoing or worsening fever, increasing cough, production of purulent sputum, haemoptysis, new shortness of breath or chest pain.
  - Antibiotics may be considered if bacterial infection suspected or if symptoms worsen/not settling; increased consideration due to diabetes.
  - Ensure ongoing routine diabetes and blood pressure reviews with usual GP; patient reports not regularly checking blood glucose at home.
